what: Robust Score Tests for Meta-Analysis Using Sign Flips
title: Robust Score Tests for Meta-Analysis Using Sign Flips
text: flipmeta performs robust score tests models fitted metafor randomly sign-flipping study-level score contributions. supports single meta-analytic model collection related model specifications share studies. collection models, flipmeta keeps study’s random sign aligned across every specification study appears. resulting joint randomization distribution can used adjust p-values testing multiple specifications coefficients. [!IMPORTANT] flipmeta currently experimental. public API returned object structure may change version 1.0.0.

title: Robust Score Tests for Meta-Analysis Using Sign Flips
text: Install development version GitHub : explicit installation flipscores currently needed GitHub dependency.
code: install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("livioivil/flipscores") remotes::install_github("filippogambarota/flipmeta")

title: Robust Score Tests for Meta-Analysis Using Sign Flips
text: input must model fitted metafor::rma.uni(). Use tested_coeffs select coefficients test. B = 999 keeps example quick. Use sign flips final analysis; default B = 5000. can also pass precomputed matrix flips exact randomization distribution must reused. main result columns : estimate se: estimates fitted metafor model; statistic: observed standardized score statistic; score: unstandardized observed score; tau2_null: heterogeneity estimated coefficient-specific null; p: sign-flip p-value.
code: library(flipmeta)  dat <- data.frame(   study_id = paste0("study", 1:12),   yi = c(.12, .31, -.04, .27, .08, .36, .15, .42, .02, .24, .19, .33),   vi = c(.04, .05, .03, .06, .04, .07, .05, .06, .03, .05, .04, .07),   dose = rep(c(0, 1), 6),   quality = rep(c("high", "low", "high"), 4) )  fit <- metafor::rma.uni(   yi,   vi,   mods = ~ dose,   data = dat )  set.seed(2026) result <- flipmeta(   fit,   B = 999,   tested_coeffs = "dose" )  result$summary_table plot(result)

title: Robust Score Tests for Meta-Analysis Using Sign Flips
text: Pass named list rma.uni models test related specifications jointly. id column must identify studies uniquely must created filtering reordering. Studies absent specification receive zero score contribution model, study retains random sign across models.
code: fits <- list(   all = fit,   high_quality = metafor::rma.uni(     yi,     vi,     mods = ~ dose,     data = dat,     subset = quality == "high"   ) )  choices <- data.frame(   selection = c("All studies", "High quality only") )  set.seed(2026) joint <- flipmeta(   fits,   id = "study_id",   B = 999,   tested_coeffs = "dose",   extra = choices,   progress = FALSE )  joint$summary_table

title: Robust Score Tests for Meta-Analysis Using Sign Flips
text: Use flipmeta::p.adjust() adjust results using joint randomization distribution. Qualifying function flipmeta:: avoids ambiguity stats::p.adjust(). Adjustments can also performed separately within families defined columns result table:
code: joint_adjusted <- flipmeta::p.adjust(joint, method = "maxT") joint_adjusted$summary_table  plot(joint_adjusted) spec_curve(joint_adjusted) joint_adjusted <- flipmeta::p.adjust(   joint,   by = "coefficient",   method = "maxT" )

title: Robust Score Tests for Meta-Analysis Using Sign Flips
text: Supported inputs univariate models produced metafor::rma.uni(); multivariate rma.mv models supported. Available heterogeneity estimators "REML", "ML", "DL", "EE"(equal-effects model). Monte Carlo p-values depend generated flips. Set seed supply flips make analysis exactly reproducible. model list, missing, duplicated, model-specific identifiers rejected invalidate alignment across specifications. numerically degenerate flip-specific variance produces error rather silently changing p-value denominator.

title: Flipmeta score sign-flipping tests for metafor models — flipmeta
text: single fitted model, object class "fm". main components : summary_table: one row per tested coefficient, containing model estimate, observed flip statistic, score statistic raw p-value; Tspace: data frame one row per sign flip one column per tested coefficient. first row contains observed statistics; scores: numeric matrix observation-level score contributions, observations rows tested coefficients columns; flips: sign-flip matrix used analysis; null_fits: fitted null model tested coefficient; rma: original refitted metafor model. list fitted models, object classes c("fml", "fm"). summary_table Tspace combine results across models, objects contains individual "fm" objects, flips common sign-flip matrix. Within every element objects, rows scores represent common universe identifiers ordered colnames(flips). Observations absent particular model score contribution zero.

Supplying different method requests refit retain fixed value ("EE" fixes zero). standardized statistic undefined flip-specific variance zero numerically degenerate; case flipmeta() reports error instead silently removing affected flips. specifications obtained selecting studies common master data set, create identifier filtering retain every model's data. example, use flipmeta(fits, id = "study_id").

title: Flipmeta score sign-flipping tests for metafor models — flipmeta
code: dat <- data.frame(     study_id = paste0("study", 1:8),     yi = c(0.10, 0.35, -0.05, 0.42, 0.18, 0.51, 0.07, 0.29),     vi = c(0.04, 0.06, 0.05, 0.08, 0.04, 0.07, 0.05, 0.06),     dose = c(0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1) )  fit <- metafor::rma.uni(yi, vi, mods = ~ dose, data = dat) result <- flipmeta(fit, B = 99, tested_coeffs = "dose") result$summary_table #>   .assign k coefficient  estimate        se statistic.rma statistic    score #> 1       1 8        dose 0.3037184 0.1665676      1.823394  1.823394 10.94687 #>   tau2_null          p #> 1         0 0.05050505  fits <- list(     all_studies = fit,     selected = metafor::rma.uni(         yi,         vi,         mods = ~ dose,         data = dat[dat$study_id != "study3", ]     ) ) joined <- flipmeta(     fits,     B = 99,     tested_coeffs = "dose",     id = "study_id",     progress = FALSE ) joined$summary_table #>         model .assign k coefficient  estimate        se statistic.rma statistic #> 1 all_studies       1 8        dose 0.3037184 0.1665676      1.823394  1.823394 #> 2    selected       1 7        dose 0.2659406 0.1758391      1.512409  1.512409 #>       score tau2_null          p #> 1 10.946868         0 0.01010101 #> 2  8.601098         0 0.01010101 joined$objects$selected$scores["study3", ] #> [1] 0

title: flipmeta 0.1.0
text: Added flipmeta() robust score testing univariate meta-analytic meta-regression models fitted metafor::rma.uni(). Added support REML, ML, DL, EE heterogeneity estimators, including models fitted fixed value tau-squared. Added joint analyses related model specifications. Study identifiers keep sign flips aligned across models studies reordered, filtered, partially shared specifications. Added coefficient selection tested_coeffs model-level metadata extra. Added reproducible analyses user-supplied sign-flip matrices. Added multiplicity adjustment flipmeta::p.adjust(), including max-T adjustment adjustments within families defined . Added print(), summary(), plot() methods single joined analyses. Added spec_curve() visualizing joined specification analyses transf_p() transforming plotted p-values. Re-exported combine_tests() combine_contrasts() flipscores. Added input validation explicit errors invalid study identifiers, incompatible flip matrices, unsupported models, numerically degenerate flip-specific variances. Added deterministic tests mathematical results, study alignment, multiple-testing adjustments, input validation, presentation methods.
